title: MAPS Image Analysis Protocol
author: jessechao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bn7dmhi6
materials: Navigate to https://github.com/jessecanada/MAPS , download the repository.

steps.title: Set up Python virtual environment
steps.instruction: Use a terminal on a Unix-type system (Linux or OSX) to manage python packages via conda.

substeps.instruction: Create a new virtual environment: conda create -n myenv python=3 (replace 'myenv' with preferred name)
Activate the virtual environment: conda activate myenv
Install required packages: conda install --file requirements.txt
Deactivate the environment at the end of the session: conda deactivate

steps.title: Perform image quality control
steps.instruction: Open 'MAPS_1_img-QC.ipynb' in Jupyter Notebook and follow the internal steps to remove blurry images.

steps.title: Build object detection model on Azure
steps.instruction: Build the first object detection model using the Azure Custom Vision service guide.

substeps.instruction: Record the endpoint, training key, prediction key, resource ID, and project ID

steps.title: Crop individual cells
steps.instruction: Open 'MAPS_2_cell-detection.ipynb' (Google Colab recommended) and follow the notebook steps to crop out individual cells.

steps.title: Generate cell galleries
steps.instruction: Choose one of two methods to generate cell galleries (Google Colab recommended).

substeps.instruction: Option 2 (Figure 5C, deep autoencoder): Open 'MAPS_3_autoencoder.ipynb' and follow instructions

steps.title: Determine localization classes
steps.instruction: Carefully inspect the generated cell galleries for wild type and a few variants to decide the number of localization classes required for classification.

steps.title: Classify phenotypes
steps.instruction: Gather cropped individual cell images and open 'MAPS_4_phenotype_classification.ipynb' (Google Colab recommended) to make predictions and classify phenotypes.

substeps.instruction: Follow notebook instructions to generate a .csv file containing predictions for each cell

steps.title: Perform training augmentation (Optional)
steps.instruction: Boost model performance by performing training augmentation once approximately 100 training images have been labeled.
